heading: The Malayan Tongue.
headings: The people in Iaua call these thus, somewhat differing from the Malay.
These are the numbers in the Malayan Speech.

book.short: A Relation of Some Yeares Travaile
book.title: A relation of some yeares trauaile begunne anno 1626. Into Afrique and the greater Asia, especially the territories of the Persian monarchie: and some parts of the orientall Indies, and iles adiacent. Of their religion, language, habit, discent, ceremonies, and other matters concerning them. Together with the proceedings and death of the three late ambassadours: Sir D.C. Sir R.S. and the Persian Nogdi-Beg: as also the two great monarchs, the King of Persia, and the Great Mogol. By T.H. Esquier·
book.author: Thomas Herbert

provenance.place: presented as from the East Indies
